description: This file defines the 'LicenseManagerClient' class in the AWS SDK for PHP. It serves as a client to interact with the AWS License Manager service, providing method signatures for various API actions with associated async versions.

classes.name: LicenseManagerClient
classes.description: A client class that enables interaction with the AWS License Manager service, offering methods for license management operations.

methods.name: createGrantVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a grant.

methods.name: createLicenseConversionTaskForResource
methods.description: Creates a license conversion task for a resource.

methods.name: createLicenseManagerReportGenerator
methods.description: Creates a report generator for license manager.

methods.name: createLicenseVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a license.

methods.name: listAssociationsForLicenseConfiguration
methods.description: Lists associations for a license configuration.

methods.name: listFailuresForLicenseConfigurationOperations
methods.description: Lists failures for license configuration operations.

methods.name: listLicenseSpecificationsForResource
methods.description: Lists license specifications for a resource.

methods.name: listLicenseVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions of a license.

methods.name: listReceivedGrantsForOrganization
methods.description: Lists grants received by an organization.

methods.name: listReceivedLicensesForOrganization
methods.description: Lists licenses received by an organization.

methods.name: listUsageForLicenseConfiguration
methods.description: Lists usage for a license configuration.

methods.name: updateLicenseSpecificationsForResource
methods.description: Updates license specifications for a resource.
